question: What phone number can I call for help with my claim 24 hours a day?
answer: For claim assistance 24 hours a day, call 044-69006900 or the toll-free number 1800 425 2255 [p.37].

question: How much notice will I get if the insurance company decides to change the terms of my policy, including the price I pay?
How often can I get a free health checkup per year?
answer: Once per Policy Year. Under SBI General Health Alpha, the Health Check Up benefit is available only once in a Policy Year to all adult members above 18 years of age [p.19]. Under Star Comprehensive Insurance Policy, the Preventive Health Check-up can be availed once per Policy Year per Insured Person who is covered as an Adult in the Policy [p.16].

question: How much is the insurance payout if I lose my thumb?
Can I add my new spouse or baby to the policy and still get some benefits right away?
How long do I have to wait before I can get coverage for something I was already sick with when I bought the policy?
Is my cataract surgery covered right away?
answer:
No. Cataract surgery is not covered right away under either health policy provided.

- Under SBI General Health Alpha, cataract is listed under "Specified Diseases and Procedures Waiting Period" and is excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage from the date of inception of the first policy [p.21].
- Under Star Health Comprehensive, treatment of cataract is listed under the specified disease/procedure waiting period (Code Excl 02) and is excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage from the date of inception of the first policy [p.31].

question: What documents do I need to provide for a claim related to my bank account?
answer:
For claims under your SBI General Health Alpha policy, you need to provide "Beneficiary bank account / NEFT details: Cancelled cheque or copy of first page of bank passbook showing account holder’s name, Account number, IFSC code, Branch name etc." [p.26]

For claims under your Star Comprehensive Insurance Policy, you need to provide "NEFT documents viz., Customer name, Bank Account No., Name of the Bank, IFSC code" [p.38]

question: What needs to happen before you will pay out under my policy?
What happens if I get hurt while flying, but I'm not a paying passenger?
answer: Under the Personal Accident cover of your SBI General Health Alpha policy, no payment will be made for any claim if you are flying in an aircraft other than as a fare-paying passenger in any scheduled airline [p.15]. Similarly, under the Star Comprehensive Insurance Policy, no claim is payable under the Accidental Death and Permanent Total Disablement section for air travel unless you fly as a fare-paying passenger on an aircraft properly licensed to carry passengers [p.35-36].
